text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Nice job, Brian.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I still couldn't bring back a first-place
finish.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You gave it everything you had though. It
was a good race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You gave it everything you had though. It
was a good race.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I have to tell you something... It's about
me, I can't...

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You can't run with your old form... Right?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You can't run with your old form... Right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...You noticed?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Not until your race just now. I saw it in how
hard you fought.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Not until your race just now. I saw it in how
hard you fought.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Even I'm not sure what's wrong with it.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just... something feels off when I try. It
doesn't work the way it did
before.

While the injury healed, it must have
changed Brian's body in small
ways—a
little shift to her balance, a slightly
different sensation in her
leg.

Combined, the changes impacted her form
enough to snatch away the
running style
Brian spent so long perfecting. It's
soul-crushing...

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
I should've told you. But I thought if I did,
you'd make me quit.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I might have.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I might have.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But things are different now. Even if you
can't run like before, you
haven't changed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
But things are different now. Even if you
can't run like before, you
haven't changed.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You want to win so badly, you'll push
through anything. The Narita
Brian who
first captivated me is still right here.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You want to win so badly, you'll push
through anything. The Narita
Brian who
first captivated me is still right here.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
It's like Sis said—you really do put your
racers first.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Good... Then I'll keep on running!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Brian's next race is the Hanshin Daishoten.
But how do we get her to
victory?

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ah, so this's where you've been! I finished
warming up!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Oh, sorry. I was thinking about what to do
for Brian's training.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I need to figure out a completely new way
of running for her that can
draw out all her
power.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... That sounds way too complicated
for me.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
There's no time for trial and error, so I was
wondering how we could
train smarter.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
There's no time for trial and error, so I was
wondering how we could
train smarter.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Ummm, arrrrgh... Yeah, smarter, but...
Argh, I wish I had the smarts to
think
smaaarteeer!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I thought it was you, Ticket. I could hear
your voice from a furlong
away.

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
Aaah! Here we go, Trainer! Someone with
a big head FULL of smarts!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Hey! I keep telling you my head is not big... Wait, what are you talking about?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Right, an intellect like hers might be
perfect!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text: Wait, what is this all about?

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
You guys sure are lively. I heard Brian's
next race is set, so I made
some rice balls
to give her a boost.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Now we've even got a running
partner!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Wow! Now we've even got a running
partner!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Huh? You wanna go one-on-one or
somethin'?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Sis and... Ama?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I asked Hayahide to help brainstorm new
training and running styles
that'd suit you
now.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And to test them out, we figured the best
running partner would be
someone you've
raced before!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
And to test them out, we figured the best
running partner would be
someone you've
raced before!

text_block_list.name: Hishi Amazon
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, that's right. Just let ol' Hishiama fix
what ails!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
A by-the-numbers approach may not be
the best for a natural-born
runner such as
yourself, but I'm sure it'll prove more
beneficial than
running blindly.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I'd hate to lose our little sibling rivalry, so
we must get you back to
your old self—no,
we must make you better than ever before.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Heh, I'll take whatever scraps I can.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: All right! Time to carve a path to victory!

text_block_list.name: Everyone
text_block_list.text: Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: I took a peek at Hayahide's training plans for you and man. A month of that, and your quads will be JACKED!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, she always takes things too
seriously, including training. No
wonder
her regimen is so effective.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You must be proud to be her sister.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: You must be proud to be her sister.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, I am.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
You two may be different, but you know
each other's racing styles so
well and were
both Racers of the Year. You're
indispensable to one
another.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! They're gonna announce the
URA awards soon, huh?

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: It should be on TV. I'll turn it on.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: It should be on TV. I'll turn it on.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
This racer topped Narita Brian's record at
the Kikuka Sho and went on
to win the
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Her sky-high success can't be stopped, so
that's why Mayano Top
Gun has been
chosen as Racer of the Year!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Oh, uh, thank you very much!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Everyone knows you had a fantastic year,
but what are your hopes for
what comes
next?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
My hopes are the same as everyone
watching—to give an ace
performance in a
mach-speed race!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Then we'll know to keep expecting big
things out of you.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Now, are there any opponents out there
that get you excited to race?

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Uh-huh! There is! Someone just like
that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
She was so amazing in last year's Hanshin
Daishoten!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: These races are all so predictable...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Awww, this doesn't get my jets burning! I
should've gone back to the
academy
instead of coming here.

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's blasted ahead! Brian's lead is only
growing now!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, no way! After all that, she's taking
off even faster?!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
She's unchallenged—no one can catch up
to her six—no, seven-length
lead! And
that's the finish!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: Wooow... That's unreal!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Seeing her run gave me a big rush. I knew I
had to run against her in a
glitzy,
supersonic race like that!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
But she got injured and started losing
races afterward...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
Still! I knew it when I raced her in the
Arima Kinen!

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text:
The tingly excitement I felt during that
race was the same as that day
I saw her in
the Hanshin Daishoten. That's why...

text_block_list.name: Mayano Top Gun
text_block_list.text: I can't wait to race Narita Brian again!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
A race between the current and former
Racers of the Year! That would
be a sight
to behold!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
She requested you specifically... and she's
quite a powerhouse too.
Mayano Top Gun
won the Arima Kinen in her classic year,
just like
you did.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Doesn't matter who I race against.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
With all this support, I refuse to yield.
Victory is mine.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah!
